name: Ichi -1-
source:
"In a public toilet stall.

Tonight, this is where me and Ichi are spending time together.
Oi, Ichi... I'm always chasing after you.
Now, I want you to look at me; to want me.

I can't keep these fantasies in my head anymore..."

You're alone with Ichi in a public toilet. Here, you can make him do whatever you want (or do whatever you want to him). Your choices are all it takes to upset him, make him feel good, embarrass him; all for your pleasure. 

Now, feel free to enjoy your hot night with Ichi.

[Translated from [url=http://www.tarutaru.com/products/ichi/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
“在公共厕所的隔间里。

今晚，这是我和一一起度过的地方。
喂，一……我一直在追你们。
现在，我要你看着我；想要我。

我不能再把这些幻想留在脑子里了……”

你和一单独在公共厕所里。在这里，你可以让他做你想做的事（或者对他做任何你想做的事）。你的选择只会让他心烦意乱、让他感觉良好、让他难堪；一切都是为了你的高兴。

现在，请随意与Ichi一起享受炎热的夜晚。

[翻译自[url=http://www.tarutaru.com/products/ichi/index.html]官网[/url]]
